instruction: Every file in in/notes/ starts with front matter between --- lines holding 'title: ...' and 'tags: a, b'. Write out/INDEX.md: the line '# Index', a blank line, then for each tag in sorted order a '## <tag>' heading, the notes with that tag as '- [<title>](<filename>)' sorted by title, and a blank line between tag sections (no trailing blank line). The files are garden.md, budget.md and trip.md.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
